physical_blocks.exact_text: Protocol: CPX-POM-001 --- DELIVERY TYPE ---- Page 1 of X

<repeat for Day 3, Day 4, Day 5, Day 6 and Day 10 visits of Cycle 1>
<for Cycle 2 to last-1 cycle, repeat from Day 1 to Day 6 visits if relevant>
<for the last cycle, repeat also for Day 22 visit and Day 28 follow-up visit>

Study Day was from the date of first dose of CPX-POM administration. Dates are displayed as DDMMMYYYY. Baseline was the last
non-missing assessment prior or on the first dose.
L = Low; H = High; VH = Very High; BP = Blood Pressure; bpm = beats per minute; ND = Not Done.
Pulse Rate: L: <55 bpm; H: 101-150 bpm; VH: >150 bpm.
Systolic BP: L: <95 mmHg; H: 131-160 mmHg; VH: >=161 mmHg.
Diastolic BP: L: <50 mmHg; H: 86-100 mmHg; VH: >=101 mmHg.
R = repeated/ unscheduled assessment.
Program: (Program name.sas) (run on: DDMMMYYYY HH:MM) Filename: (Specify file name.rtf)
